description: This file defines a class for transforming HTML attributes related to safe object embeds, specifically setting default 'type' attributes for objects such as flash content.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeObject
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform to ensure object tags have a default 'type' attribute, supporting flash objects.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Sets a default 'type' attribute to 'application/x-shockwave-flash' if not already specified, for secure object embedding.
